title: Teamcenter Administrator (Oracle Database Connectivity)  | 8 YOE | Meerut | Onsite | Immediate Joiner | Teamcenter NX integration Must
description:
𝗝𝗼𝗯 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 – Teamcenter Administrator | Job Title: Teamcenter Administrator | Experience: 8+ Years | Technology: Siemens Teamcenter 2606

𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲: Teamcenter Administration, Upgrade & Infrastructure Management

𝗝𝗼𝗯 𝗢𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄

We are looking for an experienced Teamcenter Administrator with 8+ years of hands-on experience in Teamcenter administration, NX integration, and Teamcenter upgrades.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in administering Teamcenter 2606, managing enterprise server components, configuring Active Workspace, FMS/FSC, Multi-Site, Store-and-Forward, Dispatcher, and Solr/Indexer services.

The candidate will be responsible for supporting Teamcenter upgrade activities across DEV, TEST, and PROD environments, ensuring system stability, performance, connectivity, and successful production deployment.

𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

 • Install, configure, upgrade, and administer Teamcenter 2606, including TC\_ROOT, TC\_DATA, Enterprise Server, Pool Manager, Active Workspace, and related server components.

 • Support DEV, TEST, and PROD upgrade execution, including pre-upgrade checks, configuration migration, deployment, smoke testing, and production cutover.

 • Work with Oracle DBAs during WE8ISO8859P1 to AL32UTF8 conversion.

 • Validate Teamcenter Unicode configuration, Japanese/multilingual data, and post-conversion application connectivity.

 • Configure and administer FMS, FSC, FCC, Teamcenter volumes, secondary cache servers, cache routing, and file-transfer validation.

 • Configure, validate, and troubleshoot Teamcenter Multi-Site and Store-and-Forward, including SMC/TcM connectivity, queues, replication, ownership, and multilingual data transfers.

 • Administer Solr/Search, Indexer, Dispatcher, license services, SSO, and Teamcenter background services.

 • Troubleshoot system performance, connectivity, and service-related issues.

 • Manage environment configurations, preference deployment, organization/access configurations, and backup/restore coordination.

 • Execute production readiness activities and support production deployment.

 • Prepare operational documentation, installation/configuration runbooks, and cutover/rollback procedures.

 • Provide post-go-live hypercare support and knowledge transfer.

 • Mandatory Technical Skills

 • Teamcenter Administration

 • Siemens Teamcenter 2606

 • Active Workspace (AWC)

 • FMS / FSC / FCC

 • Teamcenter Multi-Site

 • Store-and-Forward

 • Dispatcher

 • Solr / Indexer

 • Oracle Database Connectivity

 • Linux / Windows Administration

 • Single Sign-On (SSO)

 • Teamcenter Upgrade and Troubleshooting

 • NX Integration

  𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗖𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗲

 • 8+ years of experience in Teamcenter Administration.

 • Hands-on experience in Teamcenter NX integration and NX upgrades.

 • Strong experience in Teamcenter installation, configuration, administration, and upgrade activities.

 • Experience managing enterprise Teamcenter environments across DEV, TEST, and Production.

 • Good understanding of Teamcenter infrastructure, server components, database connectivity, and file management.

 • Experience troubleshooting Multi-Site, Store-and-Forward, FMS/FSC, and indexing-related issues.

 • Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

 • Key Requirements at a Glance

Interested candidates with relevant Teamcenter Administration and upgrade experience are requested to share their updated resumes along with their total experience, relevant experience, current location, notice period, and contact details.

title: Contract Role || Informatica MDM (Banking Customer 360 Transformation)
description:
**Company Description**
Verma Consultancy Services (VCS) designs resilient software architectures, privacy-first artificial intelligence, and high-assurance enterprise solutions for complex environments. The organization focuses on local data sovereignty, zero-telemetry defense, and mission-critical engineering to support secure and reliable digital transformation. VCS collaborates with enterprises, educational institutions, and high-growth technology companies across diverse industries. Its services are delivered through proprietary production software platforms and specialized engineering and talent practices, offering both technical solutions and expert consulting support.

**Role Description**
The Contract Role || Informatica MDM (Banking Customer 360 Transformation) is a full-time, on-site position based in Meerut. The role involves working closely with business and technology stakeholders to support banking Customer 360 transformation initiatives using Informatica MDM. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding and documenting contractual aspects of MDM implementation, aligning technical delivery with contractual obligations, and supporting governance around data, integrations, and service levels. The professional will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure that project contracts, SLAs, and agreements are correctly interpreted and followed, and that risks and dependencies are transparently managed. The position requires maintaining clear communication channels, tracking contract performance, and contributing to continuous improvement of processes and documentation.

**Banking/Finance Domain**

: 10+ yrs.**

  **Customer 360 solution**
